announcement.label: v0.2 prep
announcement.title: The main extension + full extension GitHub are getting their public refresh soon.
announcement.text: Current target is within about a week from August 13, 2026 (around August 20 or earlier). The dev build will keep getting v0.1.8.x updates while I finish cleanup/testing, and v0.2 itself only goes live when I am happy with it.
